about.title: Certified structural steel specialists.
text: We are All Steel Welding, a certified minority-owned and operated company specializing in complete, responsive structural steel fabrication and erection services. Our core mission is to deliver superior structural framing for your new construction or renovation projects, driven by our years of experience and skill.

We offer a turn-key system covering every need, including mezzanines, stairs, railings and roof supports. We collaborate closely with your architects and engineers and provide shop drawings for your approval.

Since 2010, we have fabricated our steel products in-house. This internal control ensures that our steel detailing, fabrication and erection are managed efficiently, guaranteeing delivery and installation are completed reliably and on schedule.

facts.heading: Safety First
items: Every team member receives orientation, substance screening, and job-specific training and evaluation, which must be passed before they may enter an All Steel Welding job site.
Each workday starts with our MOVE-IT program followed by pre-task planning, so every employee helps identify and reduce risks before work starts.
Employees are continuously evaluated by their supervisors, management and outside third-party safety consultants.

facts.heading: Join Our Team
facts.text: We seek skilled, safety-focused welders and ironworkers committed to quality and professionalism. Apply through the form on our employment page with your resume (doc or pdf, up to 2 MB).

facts.text: We love our customers, so feel free to visit during normal business hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, at 220 Grand Street, Channelview, Texas 77530.
